description.ja: アニメ『マクロス』40周年に合わせ、BANDAI SPIRITS 「マクロス」プラモデル新シリーズがHGにて始動！第１弾は
description.en: To coincide with the 40th episode of the anime "Macross ", the new BANDAI SPIRITS " Macross" plastic model series has started at HG! The first part is

description.ja: ■「変形」「フォルム」「可動」を再検証し生み出した、新たなシステム「差替三段変形（ショートカットチェンジ）」を新たに搭載。
description.en: • Equipped with a new system, "Shortcut Change ", a new system created by reexamining " transformation ", " form ", and " movability".

description.ja: ■パーツ差し替えを取り入れた新たな変形機構を採用することで、変形シークエンスの簡略化を実現。バトロイド、ガウォーク、ファイターへ簡単に変形が可能。
description.en: • By adopting a new transformation mechanism that incorporates parts replacement, the transformation sequence has been simplified. Easily transforms into Battroid, Gerwalk, and Fighter.

description.ja: ■「差替三段変形（ショートカットチェンジ）」により、変形機構を再現した際に生じる造形の制約に左右されず、各形態のフォルム、設定イメージを追求し立体化。
description.en: • With "3-step replacement transformation (shortcut change)", we pursue the form and setting image of each form and make it three-dimensional, without being influenced by the modeling constraints that occur when reproducing the transformation mechanism.

description.ja: ■複雑な構造を排除することで本体内部に可動域を設け、今までにない新次元の可動性能を実現。
description.en: • By eliminating complicated structures, we have created a range of movement inside the main body, achieving a new dimension of movement performance never seen before.

description.ja: ■キャノピー部分には「偏光成形」を採用。光の当たり方で変化する色合いを楽しめる。
description.en: • "Polarized molding" is used for the canopy part. You can enjoy the colors that change depending on how the light hits it.

description.ja: ■「ピンポイントバリアパンチ」再現用エフェクトパーツが付属。
description.en: • Includes effect parts to reproduce "Pinpoint Barrier Punch".

description.ja: ■極薄ながらも優れた隠蔽性を発揮し、濃い成形色のパーツの上からでも、鮮やかなカラー再現が可能なネーマーシールが付属。
description.en: • Comes with Naemar Seal, which is extremely thin but has excellent concealment properties, and allows for vivid color reproduction even over dark molded parts.

accessories.en: Fighter form reproduction parts x 1 set

accessories.ja: ガウォーク形態再現用パーツ×１式
accessories.en: Gerwalk form reproduction parts x 1 set
